subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should selected TTS providers remain best-effort with automatic fallback, fail closed when the configured provider fails or skips, or expose an opt-in strict/no-fallback mode for auto-TTS and `/tts`?
rationale: Current docs and tests preserve automatic fallback, while this issue asks for provider stickiness when ElevenLabs is selected; changing that default is a product and compatibility decision, not a narrow source cleanup.

options.title: Preserve default fallback with optional strict mode
options.body: Keep the shipped automatic fallback behavior for compatibility and add explicit strict/no-fallback behavior only if maintainers approve a user-visible control.

options.title: Fail closed for configured providers
options.body: Make a selected provider error stop TTS instead of falling back, accepting a compatibility break for users who rely on fallback audio.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Treat the current `/tts status` attempt chain and fallback visibility as the intended resolution and close the remaining stickiness request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Preserve default fallback with optional strict mode
recommendation.body: Keep the shipped automatic fallback behavior for compatibility and add explicit strict/no-fallback behavior only if maintainers approve a user-visible control.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged diagnostics work and documented the remaining provider-stickiness policy scope in the issue discussion.
